Also re-opened packet.js veda 75 --verse 7.100.6: Sāyaṇa quotes the same Nirukta verbatim, marked (निरु. ५, ७-८), so the evidence words are found. The sentence (either disparaging, with Aupamanyava, or a name of praise, enveloped in rays) is carried by Yāska’s words; it states the disparaging sense plainly without its detail, which is neither softened nor sensationalised. Locator 5.7 to 5.8 matches Sarup. The packet’s ‘nothing on 7.100.6’ for Yāska is a miss: the Nirukta does treat this verse, so the roster trap is met. Plain sense: 7.100.3 to 4 give the strides, 7.100.5 lauds the name, 7.100.6 is sixth of seven. verse.js ok (7.100.6 at [615,6]); entry-check ok.
